title: Restore/import never sets category_groups.is_credit_card_payments, so no card is ever linked on an imported budget and card debt never reaches a payment envelope
notes:
Cause of the owner's 'RTA above cash' on budget Casa. api/src/budget/store/restore.ts:141 inserts groups with only (id, budget_id, name, sort_order), so is_credit_card_payments (and internal) fall back to false for every restored/imported budget. The only writer of that flag is insertCardPaymentsGroup (api/src/budget/store/accounts.ts, called when a card ACCOUNT is created) — an import never goes through it. resolveCardLinks (client/src/domain/payments.ts) only looks at categories inside groups flagged is_credit_card_payments, so on Casa zero categories qualify; both cards run unlinked under the card:<accountId> envelope key (spec P8) and the category named 'Itau Cartão' is an ordinary spending category. Consequence: card spending funds no envelope, every cash payment to the card is 'paid' with nothing 'funded' -> envelope goes negative (Casa 2026-11: Itau -11.850,84, Nubank -4.523,31) while card debt stays outside the identity; the page showed those envelopes as 0,00 until the vyk0 fix gave them a row. Not fixed in vyk0: it changes linkage for every existing budget, and repairing Casa's existing data needs a migration/relink decision, not an engine change. Verify first that the YNAB import path (restore.ts) is the one Casa came through.
Facts (step 1), at HEAD a5d37bb in this worktree:

WHERE THE FLAG IS SET (writes of true)
- api/src/budget/store/accounts.ts:126-134 `insertCardPaymentsGroup` is the ONLY writer: INSERT
  category_groups (name 'Credit Card Payments', sort_order 0, is_credit_card_payments = true,
  internal = true). Called from api/src/budget/routes/accounts.ts:71-76 `ensureCardPaymentCategory`,
  which the create-account handler calls at routes/accounts.ts:102 when type === 'creditCard' &&
  on_budget. Account rename reuses the same assumption (store/accounts.ts:196-208
  `renameCardPaymentCategory` renames the category inside the flagged group).
- api/src/budget/store/budgets.ts:196-208 (fresh start / duplicate) copies
  is_credit_card_payments and internal through the group copy.

WHERE A BUDGET IS CREATED/FILLED WITHOUT IT
- Restore: api/src/budget/store/restore.ts:139-145 `insertRestoredGroup` inserts
  (id, budget_id, name, sort_order) only, so both columns fall back to false for every restored
  group; the payload has no field for them (shared/src/contracts/budget/schemas.ts:242
  `groups: z.array(z.string())`).
  POST /budgets/restore is the only import path in the repo (no YNAB/CSV import route exists).
- Restore also flattens account type: store/restore.ts:176-190 `insertRestoredAccount` writes
  'checking', 'CASH' for EVERY account, so a restored credit card is a cash account: even with the
  group flagged nothing could link (second, independent loss on the same path).
- Fresh budget: store/budgets.ts inserts the default group 'Geral' unflagged — no cards exist yet,
  not a loss. Group create (store/groups.ts:15-22) — user groups, not a loss.
- Bank account linking creates no accounts: api/src/connections only maps upstream accounts onto
  existing rows, so it cannot lose the flag.
- "Create account" for a card is the one path that sets it (routes/accounts.ts:102).
- Casa itself was imported by the uncommitted script api/scripts/import-prod/sink.ts (branch
  tk/budget-2bqe, not on main): a raw row copy that keeps account type but writes category_groups
  without the flag. Not repo code yet; the repo-side fix has to cover restore + existing data.

WHO READS IT
- client/src/domain/payments.ts:33-45 `resolveCardLinks` (flag-filtered groups, exact name match,
  plus a 1:1 fallback), used by client/src/domain/zeroSum.ts:189 (spec P8, the only resolver).
- api/src/budget/store/accounts.ts:204 (rename) and the categorize suggestion read path, which
  excludes flagged/internal groups (docs/decisions.md:1972-1978).

CASA AS STORED (budgetnew_dev, budget b35979ff-cce2-4226-9d70-bfc8b45bf1ec, 4376 transactions)
- 8 live groups, NONE flagged; "Credit Card Payments" is an ordinary group holding exactly ONE live
  category, "Itau Cartão". No "Nubank Cartão" category exists anywhere (not even soft-deleted).
- Two live, open, on-budget creditCard/CREDIT accounts: Itau Cartão (cleared -20588880, uncleared
  -859260 milliunits), Nubank Cartão (cleared -2950360, uncleared 891340).
- So the premise "two categories matching the two cards" does not hold: 1 category vs 2 cards. The
  unambiguous one-to-one rule therefore will NOT flag Casa; a repair that guessed here would be
  deciding which card "Itau Cartão" pays.
- 2026-11 assignment on the Itau Cartão category is -97235070 milliunits = -R$97.235,07 (stored).

Facts established before the stop (step 1, collected from the DB copy and the code on main HEAD):
- The flag is written in exactly one place: api/src/budget/store/accounts.ts:126-134 insertCardPaymentsGroup (is_credit_card_payments + internal = true), called from api/src/budget/routes/accounts.ts:71-77 ensureCardPaymentCategory, called only when a card account is created (creditCard + on_budget). Cloning a budget copies the flag (api/src/budget/store/budgets.ts:196-208); nothing else sets it.
- Paths that fill a budget without it: POST /budgets/restore (api/src/budget/store/restore.ts:139-147 inserts groups with only id/budget_id/name/sort_order), any import that funnels through restore, and the account-creation path when an unflagged group already exists (ensureCardPaymentCategory always creates a NEW flagged group, ignoring a same-named unflagged one). Restore additionally writes every account as type 'checking', account_group 'CASH' (store/restore.ts:176-190), so a restored card is not a card at all. Bank linking (api/src/connections) never creates accounts, so it is not a path.
- resolveCardLinks (client/src/domain/payments.ts:33-46) links a payment category to a card by exact name (`c.name === card.name`) inside groups flagged is_credit_card_payments, with a fallback only when exactly one card and one category remain unlinked; a card is an on_budget account with account_group 'CREDIT'. Casa today: group "Credit Card Payments" unflagged, ONE live category "Itau Cartão" (not two — no Nubank payment category exists), two open card accounts Itau Cartão and Nubank Cartão, so the strict one-to-one repair rule from step 3 does NOT match Casa as it stands.

Step 5 answer: the stored 2026-11 assignment of -97.235,07 on "Itau Cartão" is not spending and not a payment: it is a negative budgeted amount, so it adds 97.235,07 back to Ready to Assign (R3 subtracts later-month assignments, so it also lowers 2026-10's RTA). It is the largest single reason Nov RTA sits 106.219,73 above cash (165.391,47 vs 59.171,74). Deleting that one assignments row (tested on the copy) moves Nov RTA to 68.156,40 while the payment envelope goes -101.696,42 -> -4.461,35; no other figure changes. Not deleted here (the brief asks for the answer, not the edit) - it is the owner's money decision.

Also measured: linking raises RTA (payment envelope overspend stays in the ledger as negative Available and is not swept from RTA, spec P5), so the fix makes the card debt visible in a payment row; it does not by itself put RTA back under cash. The -97.235,07 row does.
